'''Darci Sertim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] attached to a civilian security force guarding a [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|hyperbaride synthesis plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]], along with her [[Twin/Legends|twin sister]] [[Marci Sertim|Marci]] and older sister [[Gayle Sertim|Gayle]]. Gayle was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Vost Tyne]], who claimed her death to be the work of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Darci and Marci went on to harbor a strong hatred against the Rebellion until they came across recently captured Rebel agents infiltrating the plant. The Rebels revealed the truth behind Gayle's death and the sisters decided to help them escape and get revenge on Tyne. Tyne found out and had the two arrested, taking Darci to his room for interrogation. During the interrogation, Marci had set the [[Hyperbaride synthesis plant|plant's]] [[Hyperbattery|hyperbatteries]] to self-destruct, causing Tyne to attempt to flee the facility. He used Darci as a hostage while he made for the [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]]. Darci was less harsh and cold-blooded than her sister, but her loyalty still remained only to herself and Marci.
